example.title: Mathias S. Sowers II Silo (grain bin), Sowers-Crawford Farms Historic District

brief: Squat corrugated galvanized-steel grain bin (listed as the farm's silo), about 21 ft across and 18 ft to the eave, bolted ring panels with vertical stiffener seams, a shallow conical ribbed steel roof with a round vent cap, and a small curved-top access hatch near the ground. Stands in long grass beside the red barn. NOTE: the vocabulary has no steel grain bin; typed as the nearest metal silo, builder should use the dimensions/colors (short, wide, corrugated, conical roof).
